_about: Authority rules for the reconciliation engine (spec 9.1-9.7, 9.13, 9.15). pipeline/resolver.py reads this file; every canonical_decisions row records rule_version. Edit here, bump rule_version, and re-run `python -m pipeline.reconcile --all` to re-decide every game under the new rules (old decisions stay in the table).

kickoff_at._about: spec 9.4 'Kickoff time'. Roles in descending authority. Roles absent from this list never decide the field.

primary_network._about: spec 9.4 'Primary television network'. Resolved from the LINEAR rows of the field 'broadcast' observations; streaming rows never become the primary (spec 9.11). hand_entered last: data/local_rights supplies a local carrier row only when no higher source lists a linear outlet.

local_carriage._about: spec 9.13: local carrier attribution goes stale in 14 days and must be re-verified at every season boundary. Hand entry (data/local_rights.json, 506sports) outranks the feeds for THIS field only.

rights_context._about: spec 9.2. How games.rights_controller_type / rights_controller_id are filled. A source whose rights_scope (sources table) equals the game's rights_controller_id keeps the rights_controller role; any other source claiming rights_controller is demoted to 'corroboration_rank' for that game.

primary_network_tiebreak._about: Within the winning source, when it lists several linear outlets for one game: national feed before home/away local feeds, then rail order from data/row_order.json[sport].

eligibility._about: spec 10. Which game_broadcasts.access_status values make profile 1 eligible, and the reason label recorded when the only path is a carrier-TBA local row. market_pending_access (E5, 2026-09-03) lists the access_status values that mean "the regional assignment has not published yet" rather than "you cannot watch this". The adapters already write 'unverified' at exactly that point (adapters/espn.py's NFL regional path and adapters/mlb.py's), so this is READ FROM THE DATA rather than from a list of call letters. A game is market pending when it is ineligible, an ACTIVE broadcast row carries one of these values, and market_coverage holds no row for that (game, network, viewer market) - i.e. the out-of-market conclusion was reached with no map to support it. Self-resolving: once the map loads, the market_coverage row exists and the game is decided normally.
